The whole tutorial first writes the function `power()`, in `src/api-service/api/utils.py`. Its tests need pytest, and
the server never does. So pytest goes into a group of its own.

## 1.2 pytest, in the dependency group test {#step-01.2}

A test calls `power()` and compares the result with the answer that we expect. pytest finds the tests of a project,
runs them, and reports each failure. The tests need pytest, but the server does not. So pytest goes into a group of
dependencies of its own, `test`.

This change came from running `uv add --group test pytest`.

The command adds pytest to the group `test` of `pyproject.toml`. It writes the exact versions of pytest and of the
packages that it needs into `uv.lock`.

```bash
uv run pytest --version
```

uv prints the version of pytest, `pytest 9.1.1` on the day of the class.

### What changed {#step-01.2-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="step-01.2-pyproject.toml-5d07e7"></a>`pyproject.toml`: pytest, in the group `test`. 5 lines added. It comes from `uv add --group test pytest`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/fc8c3bce83604277393460c4eb243d176d51905c/pyproject.toml){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `"pytest>=9.1.1",`
- <a id="step-01.2-uv.lock-8356d8"></a>`uv.lock`: the exact version of pytest, and of the packages that it needs. 71 lines added. It comes from `uv add --group test pytest`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/fc8c3bce83604277393460c4eb243d176d51905c/uv.lock){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

<details><summary>The diff of <code>pyproject.toml</code></summary>

```diff
@@ -11,3 +11,8 @@ dependencies = []
 package = false
 # uv sync and uv run install every dependency group, not only dev
 default-groups = "all"
+
+[dependency-groups]
+test = [
+    "pytest>=9.1.1",
+]
```

</details>
